analysis:
No concrete security regression is supported by the supplied evidence. The PR adds a build-declared public Qwen27 tensor assistant (ClusterPublicModel.tensorAssistant). It is dormant: this build declares none, and docs/reference/configuration.md says the same.

The relaxed enforcement is ClusterConfiguration.swift head lines 175-176. The old rule required nativeMember == nil beside an assistant. The new rule allows an assistant beside nativeMember only if ClusterPublicModels.tensorAssistant(for: capability)?.policy == tensorAssistant. A nil declaration compares false, so it fails closed, and equality covers depth, inventory SHA and verification. The refusal text changed only in wording.

Other changes reviewed:
- The resource-policy digest now includes the declared assistant's launch arguments and evidence hash (DistributedInstalledNativeStart.resourcePolicySHA256). It is byte-identical when nothing is declared. ClusterRuntimeApprovalFacts.describe uses the same declaration, so release facts, approval and start stay consistent. This is a tightening, in line with TB-011 and T-054.
- requireDiscoveredQuote requires the quoted policy to equal the declaration exactly.
- discoveryMode enables the assistant under auto only when declared.
- ProviderLoop+ClusterPairSlot sets the MTP status to configured and active when readiness carries an assistant. This is self-reported telemetry (T-056), with no authorization effect that I could see.
- publicTrafficLine is display-only.
- Other changes are docs, a changelog and tests.

Unverified contracts, which need a source-level pass:
- ClusterPublicModels.current versus .declared. @TaskLocal declarationOverride is documented as test-only, and I saw no product setter, but I could not rule one out.
- The evidenceSHA256 is shape-checked at runtime; per the docs, binding to the report is enforced only by tests.
- Coordinator handling of MTP fields and whether assisted speculative output is covered by parity qualification. The declaration is an owner assertion, and the docs say the evidence is recorded on a non-production pair.
- ClusterPlacementTensorAssistantSelection.readAutomatic with coordinator: true.

Several patch excerpts were truncated, and only part of the integration source was replayed (complete=false). That is a coverage limit, not evidence of safety, so I set needs_deeper_review to true.
